CA.rationale: Content identification (color) is explicitly linked to a processing/origin condition (command_estimate) for the same candidate/time.

COD.rationale: Content (red) is identified and accompanied by an explicit origin/organization field that also conveys status (history_estimate) for the same referent/time.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

A.rationale: Processing-related conditions (peaks, command_estimate origin) are explicitly linked to specific candidate content representations.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content-identification entries name content (red/blue) and their coordinates in current representations.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields (copied_prior_record vs history_estimate) separately attribute status/organization distinct from content identity.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/inheritance fields and candidate/current labeling describe how content is organized, represented and accessed over time.
